purpose: Assess whether AODN Reef Life Survey and partners have repeated site/time complete-survey denominator suitable for multi-island temporal occupancy tests. This stage has no fish species detections.

logic.survey_event: one unique, physically valid, nonduplicated source survey_id and valid YYYY-MM-DD date
logic.temporal_date: valid date 1992-01-01 to 2026-10-19; no time-of-day needed
logic.site_coordinate_stability: max observed coordinate span <=0.01 degrees latitude and longitude; attrition if greater
logic.primary_program: RLS (label contains standalone RLS), analysed separately from ATRC and mixed/other
logic.calendar_pair: same program, same official site identity, same calendar month at t and t+1
logic.strict_geographic_group: program, country, area, location; not yet independently surveyed island/archipelago

output.study_source: report physical geographic group counts, year span, program label, distinct sites and strict next-year sample opportunities
output.bounded_group_report: at most 150 stable group records sorted by physical support (also count unreported groups)

scientific_next_gate: Map independently verified reef sites to actual island polygons using marine-appropriate distance-to-coast and geological-origin annotations. Freeze fish Method 1 survey-matching and non-detection interpretation before accessing fish data.
